messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Multiple 502/504 spikes observed in eu-north1a -> hosted inference gateway (aggregate 502 rate +12% over 5m). Correlation: increased retransmits on egress path. Thread started 3345678901

beth: getting customer P0s — several customers reporting timeouts and 5xx since ~15:30 UTC. first report: acct/greenleaf, huge impact.

alex: observed same in dashboards: per-route latency up, request failures show 502 gateway. Not seeing application errors.
maria: can we confirm network metrics? packet loss, retransmits?
carlos: netops — traceroute from eu-north1a-host-7 to carrier 203.0.113.45 shows asymmetric path: hops 4-6 micro-reordering. attaching quick output:
```
traceroute to 203.0.113.45 (203.0.113.45), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.1.2 (10.0.1.2)  0.25 ms  0.23 ms  0.21 ms
 2  198.51.100.1 (198.51.100.1)  1.84 ms  1.79 ms  1.70 ms
 3  * * *
 4  198.51.100.9 (198.51.100.9)  5.11 ms  10.42 ms  5.08 ms
 5  198.51.101.14 (198.51.101.14)  25.23 ms  24.83 ms  60.47 ms
```

beth: that RTT jump and occasional * are consistent with microbursts on carrier link. Do we have packet loss graphs?

carlos: yes — cloud egress metrics show 2-3% packet loss bursts correlating with 5xx windows (see spike at 15:28-15:36). Also TCP retransmits up ~18%.
maria: customer repro steps: curl to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate with model=redwood-base reproduces 502 ~1/10 requests from eu-north1 region. Repro script:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"; done
```

alex: good repro. Does retrying succeed?
beth: often retries succeed after 1-2s, which points to transient network. But some longer tails.
support: we've opened CS ticket 11234 for Greenleaf, flagged for priority SLA credit. Customer wants ETA and mitigation.
carlos: immediate mitigation options: 1) route traffic to eu-north1b/1c (same region other AZs) if healthy; 2) failover customers to eu-west1 for critical requests; 3) request carrier to investigate BGP path (we see AS-path changes correlated).
maria: what's the risk of mass AZ failover? We need to consider KV cache warmup for chat sessions.
alex: we can do targeted routing policy change per-customer to shift Greenleaf and other P0s to eu-north1b. That avoids global failover.
carlos: implemented a canary reroute for Greenleaf at 15:46 UTC (policy change id reroute-eun1-3345). Monitoring...
oncall-bot: ROUTE UPDATE: policy reroute-eun1-3345 applied to account:greenleaf — traffic now directed to eu-north1b pool.
beth: early telemetry: Greenleaf failures dropped to 0.5% within 30s. Other customers still seeing issues.
alex: starting wider reroute for top-10 impacted customers now. Will coordinate with netops.
carlos: opened carrier ticket CT-789 (provider: NordLink) referencing possible bufferbloat on transit interface and AS-path oscillation. Provide packet captures.
maria: please capture tcpdump on edge hosts for one minute window when spike occurs, send pcap to carrier.
carlos: tcpdump done and uploaded to secure bucket s3://redwood-incidents/eun1/3345678901/tcpdump.pcap. Link (internal): https://internal.redwood/s/abc123
beth: SRE note: we temporarily increased internal retry budget for gateway layer to 3 attempts with short backoff to reduce surface for customer-facing errors while carrier investigates. Watch for amplification of load.
alex: CPU on gateway nodes spiked ~20% after retry bump but within headroom. No memory pressure.
support: communicated to Greenleaf: "We routed your requests to an alternative AZ to restore stability. Root cause appears to be a transient transit network degradation. We're working with our provider and will follow up with RCA."
carlos: carrier replied: seeing microbursts at 15:25-15:40 caused by upstream peering; investigating. Asked us to shift traffic off impacted egress IPs while they patch.
maria: next actions: 1) keep targeted reroutes for P0s until carrier confirms fix; 2) collect post-incident perf windows and share with customers; 3) prepare RCA draft including traceroutes, packet loss graphs, tcpdump excerpt, retry policy changes, and customer mitigations.
beth: also add follow-up: update runbook to include quick per-account AZ reroute steps and note KV cache impacts.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation in place. Next status at 16:15 UTC or on-demand.
alex: will run a few longer repros across region to validate stability, report back.
